items.markdown:
**Taste Skill** is an open-source anti-slop frontend framework and collection of `SKILL.md` rules that train AI coding agents to build custom, non-generic user interfaces.[[1]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VdfhAOE5aSc)[[3]](https://daily.dev/posts/frigmqy2v)

### Key Features

- **Anti-Slop Rules:** Explicitly bans generic AI design tropes like purple-blue gradients, centered three-card feature grids, excessive em-dashes, and generic Inter font pairings.[[1]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/guide)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wEGVxJjlpkk)[[3]](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/vaibhavsisinty_this-one-skill-will-make-everything-you-build-activity-7490653178611408896-ig2Q)
- **Design Dials:** Controls output using parameters for design variance, motion intensity, and visual density.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VdfhAOE5aSc)
- **Real-World Reference Extraction:** Uses scripts to parse real-world design files and open-source imagery (from Wikimedia, Met, or Openverse) instead of flattening looks into vague text summaries.[[1]](https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill)[[2]](https://agenticskills.io/skills/taste-skill)
- **Specialized Variants:** Offers multiple modular skills including `minimalist-skill`, `brutalist-skill`, `soft-skill` , and `gpt-tasteskill`.[[1]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/)[[2]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/docs)

### Installation & Compatibility

- **Installation Command:** Run `npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill` in your terminal.
- **Supported Agents:** Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, v0, and Lovable.
- **Framework Agnostic:** Compatible with React, Vue, Svelte, Next.js, or plain HTML.[[1]](https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill)[[2]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/docs)[[3]](https://daily.dev/posts/frigmqy2v)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wEGVxJjlpkk)[[5]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/guide)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VdfhAOE5aSc)

You can explore the project documentation on the [Taste Skill Official Website](https://www.tasteskill.dev/) or review the source repository via [Taste Skill GitHub](https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill).[[1]](https://www.tasteskill.dev/)[[2]](https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill)Are you trying to set this up with a specific AI coding agent like **Claude Code** or **Cursor** ? Let me know and I can share the exact setup workflow.
